teaser.en: A bitter-leaved bush with fluffy white flower heads, a close cousin of the famous bitter leaf.
teaser.sw: Kichaka chenye majani machungu na vichwa vya maua meupe laini kama pamba, binamu wa karibu wa *bitter leaf* maarufu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha makodza ga utsungu chenye vitswa vya maruwa vyereru, laini dza pamba, ndugu wa phephi wa *bitter leaf* inayomanyikana sana.

summary.en: Mtsungutsungu is Vernonia colorata, a shrub of the daisy family with bitter leaves. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mtsungutsungu ni Vernonia colorata, kichaka cha familia ya Asteraceae (jamii ya daisy) chenye majani machungu. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: *Mtsungutsungu* ni *Vernonia colorata*, chitsaka cha jamii ya *daisy* chenye makodza ga utsungu. Pakia anaandika dzinare ra Chidigo tu.

about.en: Mtsungutsungu is a soft-wooded shrub or small tree, usually 2 to 5 m tall. Its leaves are fairly large, oval and finely toothed, and taste very bitter. At the ends of the branches it carries broad, flat-topped clusters of small white or pale mauve, fluffy flower heads, followed by tiny seeds with tufts of bristles that blow away in the wind.
about.sw: Mtsungutsungu ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye mbao laini, kwa kawaida wenye kimo cha mita 2 hadi 5. Majani yake ni makubwa kiasi, yenye umbo la yai na meno madogo, na yana ladha chungu sana. Kwenye ncha za matawi huzaa vishada vipana vyenye vilele bapa vya vichwa vidogo vya maua laini kama pamba, meupe au ya zambarau hafifu, yakifuatwa na mbegu ndogo sana zenye vishungi vya manyoya magumu vinavyopeperushwa na upepo.
about.dg: *Mtsungutsungu* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa mbao laini, kpwa kawaida wa mita 2 hadi 5. Makodzage ni makulu chidide, ga umbo ra tumbi, genye meno madide kanda-kanda, na gana utsungu sana. Kpwenye ntsa za panda unalavya mafungu mapana ga dzulu sawa-sawa ga vitswa vidide vya maruwa vyereru au zambarau ngushu-ngushu, laini dza pamba, na badaye tembe ndide sana zenye nyere zinazophepheruka na phepho.

where.en: It grows in bushland, forest edges, fallow land and riverine thicket across tropical Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka, pembezoni mwa misitu, mashamba yaliyoachwa na vichaka-mwitu vizito vya kando ya mito kote katika Afrika ya kitropiki.
where.dg: Unamera weruni, kanda-kanda ya matsaka, kpwenye minda iriyorichwa na vitsakani kanda-kanda ya miho, kahi ya tsi za dzoho za Afrika.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Elsewhere in Africa the bitter leaves are widely used in traditional medicine and sometimes eaten like the related bitter leaf, Vernonia amygdalina.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo. Kwingineko barani Afrika majani yake machungu hutumika sana katika tiba asilia, na wakati mwingine huliwa kama mmea wa jamii yake, *bitter leaf*, Vernonia amygdalina.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Chidigo. Kpwenye seemu zanjina za Afrika, makodza higa ga utsungu nkuhumirwa sana kpwa dawa za chienyeji, na mara zanjina nkuriwa dza ndugu yao, *bitter leaf*, *Vernonia amygdalina*.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsungutsungu but gives no meaning or shared names. In Mgombato tsungutsungu is a very small black ant, but no link to the plant is recorded. Its scientific name is Vernonia colorata (also Gymnanthemum coloratum).
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsungutsungu lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Katika Mgombato, tsungutsungu ni sisimizi mdogo sana mweusi, lakini hakuna uhusiano na mmea huu uliorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Vernonia colorata (pia Gymnanthemum coloratum).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtsungutsungu*, ela kalavya mana ya dzina hiri wala madzina ganagohumirwa ni luga zanjina. Kpwenye Mgombato, *tsungutsungu* ni sisimizi mdide sana mwiru, ela takuna ariyeandika kukala dzina ra mmea uhu rinalavywa kula kpwa sisimizi uyu. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Vernonia colorata* (piya *Gymnanthemum coloratum*).

reason.en: Another shrub of the daisy family
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine cha familia ya Asteraceae (jamii ya daisy)

reason.en: Brachylaena, a tree of the daisy family
reason.sw: Brachylaena, mti wa familia ya Asteraceae (jamii ya daisy)

mgombato: tsungutsungu (-) very small black ant; chungu, chunguchungu.
